propositions: HTTP 429 responses with Retry-After headers are not retried on idempotent reads in Jira Data Center adapter, causing rate-limited requests to fail immediately
The retry mechanism must apply Retry-After header value plus up to 20% jitter, clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S, and must reuse existing parse_retry_after parser and constant

Mutations (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, add_label, etc.) must never retry on 429 to prevent duplicate writes; rate-limit retry must default to OFF and be explicitly opted into per call site

Rate-limit retry opt-in must flow through both PATH A (_paged_search -> _call_logged -> _with_connection_retry) and PATH B (direct _with_connection_retry calls like get_comment_map's per-issue fetch), as PATH B is the highest-volume read most likely to be rate limited
Four specific read call sites must opt into 429 retry: get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map (_paged_search), get_comment_map (per-issue fetch), and get_parent_map
Cap exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429, never allowing raw JIRAError to escape the adapter boundary
